description: Kam Labs is a Nigerian hardware + AI startup (NVIDIA Inception). We build computer-vision systems for football clubs and field-capture tools for farms and forest reserves. Skills: Python, CV/ML, geospatial data, web apps, hardware. For Field Shift we'll build a farm planner for Nigerian smallholders from NASA POWER, SMAP and IMERG, checked against our own ground footage. Looking for: remote sensing/GIS, agronomy or climate science, and UI/UX design. Real farms, real data, real deployment.
